$comment: Single source of truth for the platform organization id that PRODUCTION may carry in
Read by scripts/gate_platform_org_pin.py (CI job `gate-platform-org-pin`). Local and any other
overlay stay free to use any id; ONLY the production overlay is pinned.
To change the pin: edit this file in a reviewed PR with explicit owner approval (CODEOWNERS
owner below). Never edit the chart to dodge the gate, and never loosen the gate's strict
comparison: the service expects the canonical TypeID, so a bare UUID, a different case or
surrounding whitespace is a different (wrong) value.
rationale: The platform organization is the only tenant in which a selection-list operator may publish a common (global) list to every organization. Its identity must therefore be the immutable root platform organization (ROOT_ORG_ID, seeded by backend/src/migrations/015_seed_root_platform_organization.ts), never an arbitrary org id: a typo or a malicious or mistaken chart edit would otherwise hand global-publish power to an ordinary org. The TypeID form is the wire form the service expects; it is the base32 encoding of the UUID above (the pin and the UUID are cross-checked by the gate).
